# dhi_mirror (Resource)

Manages a DHI mirrored repository configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_name` (String) Destination Docker Hub repository name.
- `source_name` (String) DHI source repository name (e.g. `golang`).
- `source_namespace` (String) DHI source repository namespace (e.g. `dhi`).

### Optional

- `create_destination` (Boolean) Whether to create the destination repository on Docker Hub if it doesn't exist.
- `destination_namespace` (String) Destination Docker Hub namespace. Defaults to the provider's `organization`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the mirrored repository.
- `is_initial` (Boolean) Whether the mirror is in initial sync state.
- `is_mirroring` (Boolean) Whether the mirror is currently syncing.
